Measures
Attachment anxiety was measured using a shortened version of the anxiety subscale of the Experiences in Close Relationships scale, consisting of the nine items that loaded most strongly on the anxiety factor in Sibley, Fischer and Liu (2005). Items were rated from 1 to 7 (α = 0.94). Social anxiety was measured with the 20-item Social Interaction Anxiety Scale (α = 0.9), and self-esteem with the 10-item Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale, rated from 1 to 4 (α = 0.85).


Data Analysis Strategy
Before scoring, negatively worded items were reverse-keyed so that higher scores reflected more of each construct. This applied to items 5, 9 and 11 of the Social Anxiety Scale and items 2, 5, 6, 8 and 9 of the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale; no attachment anxiety items were reversed. Scale scores were calculated as the mean of each participant’s item responses using scoreItems() from the psych package, and internal consistency was assessed with Cronbach’s alpha.
